text:
No tree-cover loss event was detected on ASSET-C (374.8 ha) between 2021 and 2025. The check was against a 31 December 2020 baseline, and Hansen Global Forest Change data covered the whole asset (valid-data fraction 1.0). The latest observed year is 2025.

Limits on this result:
- Only events of 0.5 ha or more are detected. Smaller losses, losses at edges, or losses narrower than the 30 m pixels may be missed, so it does not prove that no change occurred at all.
- It is not a regulatory or compliance finding, such as EUDR status.
- It says nothing about periods outside 2021–2025.

For context, JRC data show about 43.3 ha of forest in 2020 (11.55% of the asset). One of the three listed sources, MGAP 2021, was unavailable, but the two sources used (Hansen and JRC) were both available.
